Rohit: Heads-up — spike in tiny GPU pod evictions in ap-southeast1c since 08:40. cost +15% and paging. anyone oncall? :grimacing:
infra-bot: ALERT: evictions[gpu-ap-southeast1c] = 5.6/min (10m avg).
Maya: we rolled gpu.family enforcement yesterday. lots of tiny pods still require rtx7 via requiredDuringScheduling -> scheduler rejects rtxA nodes even if free GPUs exist; tiny pods cram on rtx7 and evict when medium jobs start.
Jun: scheduler log sample: "Binding failed for pod ml/tiny-42: no nodes available that match nodeAffinity (gpu.family in [rtx7])"
Kira: quick hotfix options: 1) bump AZ warmpool, 2) flip a few rtxA nodes' taint to PreferNoSchedule, 3) mutate strict nodeAffinity -> preferred for pods requesting <=1 GPU.
Rohit: I'll scale warmpool 6->14 now and open TICKET-7761.
infra-bot: RUNBOOK: warmpool scale invoked by Rohit at 2025-03-23T08:46:12Z (run id rp-7761).
Maya: canarying mutating webhook to ml namespace to rewrite required->preferred for label ml:tiny at 10% traffic.
Jun: after actions, evictions dropped to ~1.0/min in 12m. keep monitoring and audit remaining required gpu.family pods.
Kira: long-term: CI gate to block required gpu.family, inventory rtx7-bound workloads, and evaluate scheduler plugin for fractional/co-packed GPUs.
